Families moving a parent into Bristal at Woodcliff Lake often have Medicare questions: what changes when someone moves, what a Special Enrollment Period is, and where to get free counseling. I would like to offer your family-relations or admissions team a free, plain-language Medicare guide for families, or a short education talk. Education only, no insurance company or plan named. I am not asking for resident names or lists, and there is no cost to you. (551) 202-9079, contact@aegissage.com.
source: Bergen County Key Services Guide 2024, "Long-Term Facilities in Bergen County" p. 28-33, from NJ Department of Health licensing data (https://bergencountynj.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ksg-2024-final.pdf)
notes: Licence type, address and phone as printed in the county guide. Website not in the guide; find it on the operator's own site before writing. Ask for the community relations or family services contact.
